definitions.explanation: A nurse who is licensed by a prefectural governor and works under the direction of a doctor or a fully registered nurse, rather than holding the national nursing qualification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{准看護師|じゅんかんごし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She works as a licensed practical nurse.

examples.japanese: {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After getting her practical nurse license, she got a job at a hospital.

examples.japanese: {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、さらに⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To become a registered nurse from a licensed practical nurse, you need to attend school further.

notes:
The prefix {准|じゅん} means "associate" or "semi-," marking a qualification one rank below the full ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧ (registered nurse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: a practical nurse license
- {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a practical nurse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧: registered nurse — holds the national qualification and may direct practical nurses
- {看護助手|かんごじょしゅ}: nursing assistant — supports nursing work but holds no nursing license
